name: Axilla
description: Neurovascular passage to the upper limb. Lymph nodes and fat are additional contents; lymphatic meshes are not provided.

Boundaries: Apex: clavicle, first rib and superior scapular border
Base: skin, subcutaneous tissue and axillary fascia
Anterior wall: pectoralis major/minor and clavipectoral fascia
Posterior wall: subscapularis, teres major and latissimus dorsi
Medial wall: upper thoracic wall and serratus anterior
Lateral wall: intertubercular region of humerus
